propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust bounded request budget with zero incrementally banked verdicts due to concurrent tool batch execution not enforced by prompt text alone.
Pydantic AI executes response tool batches concurrently, allowing deferred record calls past the budget boundary despite prompt-only serialization instructions.

A completion-only wrapper enforces at most one governed repository action per run_step and invokes provisional met=false banking on the third evidence response if still unbanked, guaranteeing progress.
The fixed completion verifier now banks criterion verdicts incrementally within three evidence responses per id, returning normal PASS/FAIL instead of CompletionRecoveryError on dense criteria.
Simple control cases (three criteria) continue to pass 3/3 with correct banking; dense oracle cases improved from 0/3 to ≥2/3 bounded success with the policy wrapper attached.
